Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q1 2021 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of MMC.
Our cloud segment grew 20% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 190 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q1 2021.
We generated $8.1 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 20% to 25% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
Thank you for the question. Our cloud segment grew 20% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
Second question - Analyst:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
While we remain optimistic, there can be no assurance that macroeconomic headwinds won't affect demand.
